# Scout-In

> AI-powered prospect research for sales teams: company analysis, decision-maker insights and personalized outreach strategies in minutes.

Scout-In automates the tedious part of B2B prospect research. Based on your own company profile, it analyzes a prospect's company data and market position, identifies decision-makers and suggests tailored value propositions and contact strategies. It is built for sales professionals, founders and consultants who want comprehensive research reports in minutes instead of hours.
